body.x: ROCKI(www.myrocki.com) presented WiFi speaker Controller 'ROCKI' at 'Digital Experience' of the 'CES 2014', the biggest IT appliances show held in Las Vegas, U.S. from January 7th to 10th.
Connecting speakers or audio systems, then control by ROCKI app linked smartphone. Also, it can sharing music with friends and create music queue.

'CES 2014(The International Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases 2,500 ~ 3,200 exhibitors in every kind of electronic appliance.More than 152,000 attendees from more than 150 countries come to the show.
